**Repaired finding submitted: deviation (INDEMN, critical), preferred level, position-complete.**

Repair made in response to the verifier:

- **Op 1 (§ 12(a)):** deleted the standalone "the Web Site or" trigger, so limb (i) now reads "any claim arising out of or relating to Client Content (including, but not limited to, any claim resulting from any content posted to the Web Site by Client or Client's employees, agent or any customer of Client granted access to the Interface by Client)". With limb (ii) ("any breach by Client of any applicable state or federal law, rule or regulation"), our indemnity is now genuinely limited to Client-provided content plus our own breach of law, and the deleted product/service-injury and site-operation exposure cannot re-enter. All retained words are verbatim.
- **Op 2 (new § 12(c)):** unchanged — TrueLink defends and indemnifies Client and its affiliates for third-party IP infringement/misappropriation claims concerning the Interface, related software, Hosting and Support Services, TrueLink's breach of law, TrueLink-caused unauthorized access to or disclosure of Client Content or Credit Data, and TrueLink's gross negligence or wilful misconduct, with prompt written notice, TrueLink control of defence and settlement, and reasonable cooperation.
- **Drafting check confirmed:** "Credit Data" is defined in § 1(d) (p0015) and "Client Content" in § 1(b), so no dangling references. No super-cap or procure/modify/replace/refund terms were added, as those are fallback-only elements and we are proceeding at preferred; the § 12 cap (Sections 3, 4, 7, 11) and existing § 12(b) indemnity are untouched. Redline validated ok:true with minimality satisfied.
